```json
{
  "title": "Project Nexus: Interactive AI-Driven 3D Product Concierge Module",
  "sprint_priority": "high",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD)

## 1. Executive Summary
**Project Name:** Project Nexus - Interactive AI-Driven 3D Product Concierge
**Objective:** To develop a high-performance, web-based module that integrates immersive 3D visualization with autonomous AI agents to guide users through complex product configurations and purchasing decisions.

Based on market research of industry leaders (Simform, Appinventiv, WillowTree), this module will bridge the gap between high-fidelity spatial computing (Three.js) and enterprise-grade agentic workflows (AI Agents) within a performant Next.js architecture.

## 2. Project Objectives
*   **Immersive Engagement:** Increase user time-on-site by 40% through interactive 3D product exploration.
*   **Conversion Optimization:** Utilize AI Agents to reduce friction in the sales funnel by providing real-time, domain-specific technical support.
*   **Performance Excellence:** Achieve a Lighthouse score of 90+ for performance and SEO using Next.js SSR and Edge computing.

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1. Core Framework (Next.js)
*   **App Router Implementation:** Utilize Next.js 14+ App Router for optimized routing and layouts.
*   **Edge Rendering:** Deploy localized edge functions to reduce latency for global users (inspired by Appinventiv’s strategy).
*   **SEO Optimization:** Automated metadata generation for 3D product states to ensure search engine visibility.

### 3.2. 3D Visualization Layer (Three.js)
*   **Interactive Configurator:** Users must be able to rotate, zoom, and modify product textures/components in real-time.
*   **React Three Fiber Integration:** Use R3F for declarative 3D component management within the React ecosystem.
*   **Mobile Optimization:** Implement simplified shaders and geometry LOD (Level of Detail) for high-fidelity performance on mobile browsers (inspired by WillowTree).

### 3.3. Intelligent Agentic Workflow (AI Agents)
*   **RAG Architecture:** Integrate a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using LangChain to provide accurate, product-specific answers (inspired by Simform).
*   **Autonomous Actions:** The agent must be capable of performing tasks such as checking real-time inventory, calculating shipping, and scheduling expert consultations.
*   **Contextual Awareness:** The AI agent must "see" what the user is doing in the 3D space and offer relevant suggestions based on the current configuration.

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements
*   **Scalability:** The module must support multi-tenant deployments for various product lines.
*   **Security:** AI interactions must be sandboxed, ensuring no PII (Personally Identifiable Information) is leaked to LLM providers.
*   **Accessibility:** Provide a 2D fallback interface for users with screen readers or low-bandwidth connections.

## 5. User Stories
*   *As a Customer,* I want to see a 3D model of the product so I can understand its physical dimensions and features before buying.
*   *As a Customer,* I want to ask an AI assistant technical questions about the product's compatibility without leaving the 3D view.
*   *As a Sales Manager,* I want the AI agent to qualify leads by capturing user preferences during the 3D configuration process.

## 6. Success Metrics (KPIs)
*   **Conversion Rate:** 15% increase in "Add to Cart" actions from the 3D module vs. static pages.
*   **Load Time:** 3D canvas initialization in under 2.5 seconds on 4G connections.
*   **AI Accuracy:** >90% success rate in resolving technical queries without human intervention."
}
```
